problem:
Which of the following matrices are in row echelon form?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}-5 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

feedback.problem:
Consider the matrix $A$ given below.
Which entries of $A$ could be replaced by $0$ in order to get a matrix in row echelon form?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Notice that by replacing ${a}_{31}$ and ${a}_{42}$ with $0$, we get a matrix in row echelon form:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]\,⟶\,[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

The other options will not give us a matrix in row echelon form.
